goal: Keep still-mineable transactions in the mempool instead of dropping them by age
Reduce network relay bandwidth wasted on rebroadcasts and eliminate mempool index maintenance overhead
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Unaddressed objection: wallet test no longer checks parent resubmission before child (fametrano)
Objection: removing expiry entirely prevents operators from reverting if harmful (ajtowns)
Support because historical reasons for mempool expiry no longer hold (stickies-v, maflcko)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because 92% of expired transactions are later mined, making age-based eviction incentive-incompatible
Eliminates wasted relay bandwidth from rebroadcasting evicted transactions
Removes index tree maintenance overhead on every mempool insertion and deletion
